semiconductor_relevance: Medium — GFPD GmbH provides specialized fume exhaust duct solutions that are relevant for semiconductor manufacturing environments due to their ability to handle corrosive fumes.
summary: GFPD GmbH is the exclusive sales distributor in Europe for ETFE coated stainless steel fume exhaust ducts, which are designed to manage corrosive fumes in various industrial applications, including semiconductor manufacturing. Their products meet stringent quality standards and can be customized for specific installation needs.
capabilities: Custom duct sizing to meet SMACNA standards

regional_presence.Europe: GFPD GmbH operates as the exclusive sales distributor in Europe for their specialized duct solutions.
